data.gender_notes: Midhah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'midhatha', which means 'delicate' or 'sweet'. In Islamic tradition, Midhah represents the gentle, compassionate, and nurturing nature of Allah. The name Midhah carries the meaning “Delicate, Sweet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Midhah usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, sweet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes Allah's gentle care and compassion towards His creation.
data.etymology: Midhah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Sweet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Midhah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
